Heirloom Gold & Bridal Light.

Heirloom gold and kundan jewellery take centre stage against a deep burgundy bridal palette. Palace colonnades, warm light and close details give the collection a regal setting while keeping the craftsmanship in focus.

The campaign pairs a 4K vertical film with bridal portraits, wide editorial frames and close jewellery details for social, lookbooks and digital showcases.
